Crowding is only a size-down caution, never a fade, but combined with negative score and the macro dominance of AI tech headlines (unscheduled_share 100%), the attention spike risk is elevated. On a mean-revert leader tape, a crowded trend-tagged theme with negative momentum offers poor risk-adjusted entry.
